entry.title: POSIX Is Not A Shell
entry.summary: When someone says "write it in POSIX shell for portability," they mean well. POSIX is a specification. Not a program. The thing that actually runs your script is bash, dash, ash, ksh, yash, or one of a dozen others. They each implement POSIX with their own gaps, extensions, and historical accidents.
